name: MMT-Bench_VAL_TH
description: A validation split of the MMT-Bench suite for Thai (TH), consisting of parallel source–target sentence pairs and reference translations for evaluating multilingual machine translation models. It is intended for automated evaluation of translation quality for Thai, enabling comparison of model outputs to human references. Typically used as part of the MMT-Bench evaluation pipeline for tracking model performance on Thai.
reputation: A component of the MMT-Bench suite; used by researchers evaluating Thai translation performance but relatively niche compared to larger multilingual benchmarks.
